context: Outlook. We provided several case studies where our fractalism technique applies. It remains open to further explore the limitations and possibilities of our technique in more contexts. Table 1 in Section 1 presents an open question which should be clarified. Moreover, we could not settle the cases for vertex deletion problems when the underlying graphs are planar. Acknowledgement. We thank Manuel Sorge (TU Berlin) for fruitful discussions.
